title: QUIC RFC 9221 DATAGRAM Foundation Work Item
summary: Implement the RFC 9221 DATAGRAM foundation, receive floor, and core outbound send floor: canonical requirement coverage, transport-parameter codec support, DATAGRAM frame codec support, 0-RTT parameter-memory validation, protected 1-RTT receive delivery/rejection, and peer-gated application DATAGRAM send support with congestion/drop and non-retransmission proof.
planned_changes:
- Add `SPEC-QUIC-RFC9221.json`, `ARC-QUIC-RFC9221-0001.json`, `WI-QUIC-RFC9221-0001.json`, and `VER-QUIC-RFC9221-0001.json`.
- Add `MaxDatagramFrameSize` to `QuicTransportParameters` and parse/format transport parameter `0x20`.
- Preserve and validate `MaxDatagramFrameSize` in 0-RTT transport-parameter memory.
- Add `QuicDatagramFrame` and DATAGRAM frame parse/format helpers for frame types `0x30` and `0x31`.
- Deliver valid protected 1-RTT DATAGRAM frames through a distinct application DATAGRAM receive effect.
- Reject received DATAGRAM frames when local receive support was not advertised, when the complete frame exceeds the advertised limit, or when DATAGRAM appears in weakly protected packet contexts.
- Add `QuicConnection.SendDatagramAsync` and a runtime DATAGRAM send event path that rejects missing peer support, rejects peer-limit overflow, emits protected 1-RTT DATAGRAM frames when permitted, accounts congestion, drops congestion-blocked sends without a transport error, avoids stream association, and marks sent DATAGRAM packets non-retransmittable.
- Add focused requirement-home tests for transport-parameter round-trip/defaults, 0-RTT remembered DATAGRAM size validation, DATAGRAM frame codec behavior, receive delivery/rejection, weak-context rejection, ack-eliciting classification, outbound send support gating, peer limit enforcement, non-fragmentation, congestion accounting/drop behavior, non-retransmission, and flow-control exclusion.
verification_plan: Run focused RFC9221 requirement-home tests, run transport-parameter and DATAGRAM frame codec filters, run core SpecTrace JSON validation, refresh generated requirement coverage triage, and run `git diff --check`. Defer HTTP Datagrams adapter behavior, optional DATAGRAM ACK/loss notifications, 0-RTT DATAGRAM transmission, and benchmark closure to follow-up slices.
out_of_scope: Public application DATAGRAM receive callback/API beyond the internal delivery effect.
HTTP/3 datagrams, capsules, CONNECT-UDP, and MASQUE behavior.
0-RTT DATAGRAM transmission while the repo's early-data application profile remains unset.
completion_notes: The work item remains in progress after the core send floor until HTTP/3 adapter integration, optional ACK/loss notifications, public receive API shape, benchmark evidence, and 0-RTT DATAGRAM send policy are implemented or explicitly deferred.
